interpretation.INPUTS_EQUIVALENT: Held-out and every CV fold are exactly equivalent and raw-target splitting reproduces the split.
interpretation.EQUIVALENT_IF_KEEPING_SPLIT: Inputs match on the historical split, but splitting the raw target changes row assignment/order. Preserve the historical indices to retain equivalence.
interpretation.NOT_PROVEN: At least one input, dtype, label code, category or finite-input check differs. This does not establish changed predictions or require rerunning every model.
interpretation.ERROR: Task could not be completely audited; see tasks.csv.
interpretation.SKIPPED_INFEASIBLE: The original sampling feasibility condition excludes this task.

limitations: The baseline uses the current local preprocessing and CSVs. Historical training data, versions and settings must match to reuse historical results.
Sampling locally preserves the target column as groupby.apply did before pandas 3; existing project code is not modified.
Corrected categorical encoders retain the existing ordinal scheme. Unknown categories use diagnostic -1 and are never certified equivalent.
Corrected numeric means are learned solely on each outer or fold training partition; label targets are never imputed.
Equal NaNs/infinities are not certified as valid model inputs. Equality uses no numerical tolerance.
Comparisons use historical fixed splits; split_same_with_raw_target separately checks splitting before label encoding.
columns.csv contains changed columns or columns with missing, infinite or unknown values; it is not a list of all features.
No predictive model is trained. Different inputs can still yield identical predictions; metrics, elapsed time and optimal hyperparameters are not estimated.
